reason: I already have a rate card, a media kit and an invoice template, so most of this I do myself. And most of my offers are cafés paying in food, so a fair-rate calculator and payment reminders don't help when there's no money to chase. I might try the free version once, but I wouldn't pay for Pro.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. Mitra helps me negotiate and collect cash, but at 2K-10K followers I mostly get barter, and I'm not letting an AI send reminders from my account to a brand I want to keep good relations with.
would_change_my_mind: If Mitra actually brought me paid brand offers, or proof that its counter-offers turned barter deals into paid ones for nano creators like me in Bengaluru.
